lanes.summary: The provided diff correctly implements the "MECHANISM HALF ONLY" of PMAT-3510. It adds the `hosts: [..]` capability to the ladder schema without adding any actual model rungs. It accurately enforces the rule that unlisted hosts skip the rung instead of failing, outputs an `[N/A]` row in `model_ladder.sh`, and correctly ratchets vs `origin/main` to prevent dropping hosts for existing rungs. All 3 described self-test cases are present and implemented correctly. No forbidden changes (e.g., adding model files) were found.

The PR implements the mechanism half of PMAT-3510 exactly as specified: optional per-rung `hosts: [..]` in the ladder contract, falsification tests FALSIFY-MCL-009/010, per-host skipping and origin/main ratchet ('hosts DROPPED') in check_model_ladder.sh, non-RED [N/A] receipt generation in model_ladder.sh, and 3 corresponding self-test cases (18 total). No rungs and no model files were added. No gates were weakened and no contradictions were found.

findings.claim: contracts/model-capability-ladder-v1.yaml documents optional hosts: [..] per rung and adds falsification tests FALSIFY-MCL-009 and FALSIFY-MCL-010 without adding any rungs or model files, matching the mechanism-only scope.
scripts/check_model_ladder.sh implements the ratchet over (rung, host) pairs against origin/main, failing with 'hosts DROPPED' if a required rung loses hosts.
scripts/check_model_ladder.sh skips a rung when the host is not listed in the rung's hosts: list without marking it as a failure.
scripts/model_ladder.sh extracts hosts: into the ladder pipeline and logs an [N/A] row with not_listed_host: true, continuing without incrementing RED.

scripts/lib/model_ladder_cases adds 3 self-test cases (green-rung-listed-one-host, red-dropped-host-on-rung, red-listed-host-absent), bringing the total to 18 cases, testing both skipping on unlisted hosts and ratcheting against dropped hosts.
